214060.postText: Fireworks in the background and Kovai Kings win by 104 runs and are the champions for TNPL 2023. Players shake hands. Nellai should not be disappointed, as they took the long route did well to reach the Finals. Excellent knocks from Suresh Kumar, Mukilesh and Atheeq Ur Rahman, then with the ball Subramanyan and Shahkrukh settled it for Kovai. Thanks for tuning in. It has been a pleasure bringing you the commentary, do join us for more matches.
